Definition: plural ordinal from G1803 and G1540; six hundred:--six hundred.
BiblicalUsage: hexakósioi means six hundred. It turns up twice, in Revelation.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is simple here: hexakósioi means six hundred, and I do not stretch it further.
RelatedEvents: The Beasts from the Sea and the Land; The Harvest of the Earth
